result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation on this food delivery app screen.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are truncated ('Smash Bros Bu...') due to items being cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousel items either fully display within the viewport or provide clear visual affordance that content is scrollable, and avoid abrupt text truncation.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries appear side by side with the same image, delivery time, and price, which looks like duplicate content.
issues.suggestion: Verify these are distinct restaurants/locations; if duplicates, remove one or differentiate them with location or branch info.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon styling is inconsistent between cards — one has a white background circle and the other a dark background circle, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and contrast treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
